sp_widget.client_script: api.controller = function() { var c = this; c.qText = ""; c.qType = "text"; c.qMandatory = false; c.addQuestion = function() { if (!c.qText) return; c.server.get({ action: "add_question", text: c.qText, question_type: c.qType, mandatory: c.qMandatory, order_num: (c.data.questions.length + 1) * 10 }).then(function(r) { c.data.questions = r.data.questions; c.qText = ""; c.qMandatory = false; }); }; };
